text:
GTA 6 Soundtrack Takes Shape as Rockstar Teases Artists - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
The GTA 6 marketing blitz is well underway, starting with that extended look from two weeks ago, and now a tease of the game's soundtrack. Popular artists such as Future, Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Raul Alejandro, and more have posted images to their social accounts featuring what appears to be art from Grand Theft Auto 6. The GTA series is known for having expansive soundtracks featuring popular artists, as well as casting those artists in voice roles in the games themselves. In other news, 007: First Light on Switch 2 has been delayed yet again, this time all the way to March 2027. The PC, PS5, and Xbox versions debuted back in May of this year. And finally, the art director for Apex Legends explains how this new Street Fighter collab gave the existing characters 'thick thighs.'

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Gallipoli Review
Gallipoli reviewed by Seth Macy on PC.

"Gallipoli is the most beautiful game in the WW1 series yet, with excellent maps, fun new classes, and a continued focus on teamwork in order to win. The hard and dry landscapes of the Middle Eastern front are recreated with exquisite attention to detail, and the active player base of people taking it seriously enough to get the job done – but not so serious as to intimidate or scare off new players – is such a rare gem in modern gaming. It's those moments, though, when everyone is doing what needs to be done – whether it's laying down covering fire for an advance, or running from teammate to teammate healing their wounds as they dig in – that Gallipoli truly becomes a one-of-a-kind gaming experience."

text:
Other Mommy - Official Trailer 2 (2026) Jessica Chastain, Jay Duplass, Arabella Olivia Clark
Take a look at the Official Trailer 2 for Other Mommy, an upcoming horror movie starring Jessica Chastain, Jay Duplass, Arabella Olivia Clark, Dichen Lachman, with Arian Moayed and Karen Allen. Experience the loving and intense embrace only a mother could provide in Other Mommy, in theaters on October 9.

From James Wan (Saw, Insidious and The Conjuring) and director Rob Savage (Host and The Boogeyman) comes a terrifying trip into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

Jessica Chastain stars in a dual role as Bela’s mother and as “Other Mommy,” a manifestation of the entity. Jay Duplass plays Daddo, Bela’s father, and Arabella Olivia Clark plays Bela. 

From Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Other Mommy is directed by Rob Savage from a screenplay by WGA award winner Nathan Elston, based on the New York Times bestselling novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman (Bird Box).

The film is produced by James Wan, p.g.a., and is executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman and Ryan Lewis. 

Other Mommy opens in theaters on October 9, 2026.

In the Apex Legends VS Street Fighter 6 event, throw down in Wildcard with the fighting styles of Ryu, Chun-Li, Akuma, and Dhalsim, launch Hadokens and Shoryukens across a remixed Olympus. The event also allows you to suit up as Street Fighter 6 characters with 8 new Legend Skins, Street Fighter 6 Weapon Skins, and the Hadoken Mythic Universal Melee. 

Apex Legends is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via EA App, Epic Games Store and Steam. The Apex Legends VS Street Fighter 6 Event arrives on September 22, 2026.
